title: Ten classic linkage maps added
summary: Ten wheat maps from the GrainGenes archive - including the ITMI Synthetic W7984 x Opata85 RFLP and microsatellite maps, the Chinese Spring x T. spelta map and the 1995 hexaploid consensus map - can now be viewed with their marker positions, bringing the viewable maps to 15.

title: Linkage (cM) view on the genome map
summary: The 37,678 QTL published with a genetic-map position only are now drawn on a linkage (cM) view, alongside the ideogram and circos views for QTL with a physical position.

title: Data release: 80,640 QTL records
summary: The QTL table was rebuilt from the final curated data set: 80,640 QTL/MTA records, 3,058 MetaQTLs and 1,226 epistatic QTL pairs. Trait statistics follow the curators' trait table, and loci reported without a name are kept as “Unnamed locus”.

title: Source publications resolved: 1,380 studies
summary: Every reference is now listed as its own publication with title, authors, journal and year, and 99.3% of QTL records carry the year of the study they came from.
